documentation.description: Explain the progress of the downsampling of indices, for the whole index and for every shard

index.description: A comma-separated list of the downsampled indices, data streams or wildcard expressions to explain

source_index.description: A comma-separated list of source index names: only the downsamples of these indices are explained

expand_wildcards.description: Whether wildcard expressions should get expanded to open, closed, or hidden indices (default: open and hidden, since downsampled indices are hidden until the downsampling succeeds)

ignore_unavailable.description: Whether specified concrete indices should be ignored when unavailable (missing or closed)

allow_no_indices.description: Whether to ignore if a wildcard indices expression resolves into no concrete indices

master_timeout.description: Timeout for waiting for a cluster state that is not blocked
